jade: Heads-up: reproducible ordering bug when ACK bundler is on under heavy offload (runc-12, batch=16 ~1.2k req/s). Pages sometimes marked resident on wrong host and subsequent touches fault.

kyle: symptom: stale residency metadata vs mmap?

jade: yep. dump shows release ack -> residency update for GPU_A, but later fault observed on GPU_B.

marta: bundler could be reordering. ACKs buffered and then sent; migration between buffer and send would be bad.

eli: trace: offload_ack t=161234.752; lease_release t=161234.753; residency_update t=161234.754 host=GPU_A; fault_on_touch t=161234.762 observed_host=GPU_B.

kyle: two mitigations: use migration tokens to serialize residency updates, or add per-allocator seq_id on page ops and drop stale messages. prefer seq_id (lower perf cost).

marta: seq_id approach: add uint32 seq_id per op, monotonic ++alloc->last_seq. Lease manager ignores incoming.seq_id < meta.seq_id. handle wrap with signed delta check.

jade: also add fast-path in fault handler: if metadata mismatch detected, signal retry to runtime instead of initiating remote-copy immediately.

eli: plan: disable bundler to confirm, then land seq checks, run 24h soak. If stable, attach seq in bundler and re-enable.

kyle: I'll open PR (meta field + tests + microbenchmark).

marta: I'll add integration tests that reorder bundles. also consider seq TTL for distributed scenarios to force sync on huge deltas.

ops-bot: CI queued 8 build/allocator-seq-check #4822 started by kyle

jade: FYI update telemetry scrapers for page_meta change. follow-up EOD. :thumbsup:
